interest: U.S. fears of Japanese bases on Madagascar, 1942.
overview: Docket for 894.20251W (1942) on suspected Japanese activity in Madagascar and plans to close the Mozambique Channel.

subfiles.about: A State Department List of Papers sheet recording incoming diplomatic and naval intelligence reports regarding alleged Japanese subversive activity and missions in Madagascar in March 1942.
subfiles.summary: Docket on Japanese activity in Madagascar: Leahy's telegram and a Navy report on three missions.
